measurement_notes: Jobs ran concurrently with each other and some PyTorch reference checks; elapsed times are functional test observations, not isolated performance benchmarks.

Native peak_device_bytes measures scratch allocations, excluding driver and BLAS overhead. NVIDIA external monitoring includes per-process and total device VRAM; AMD counters are total device VRAM and include other processes.
Native seconds excludes GLB serialization. Native peak_host_bytes is process-lifetime peak RSS; external samples are taken once per second and can miss brief allocation peaks.
Both checkpoint header hashes and streamed full-file SHA256 hashes are recorded. The original NAF checkpoint has a separately enforced SHA256 before conversion.

The complex CPU house attempt was stopped partway through shape512 and is not a completed run. The final CPU run uses the reproducible narrow pencil RGB+mask fixture with unchanged resolution and steps.
